quote.text: Most good programmers do programming not because they expect to get paid or get adulation by the public, but because it is fun to program.
quote.fr: « La plupart des bons programmeurs programment non pas parce qu'ils espèrent être payés ou admirés du public, mais parce que programmer, c'est amusant. »
quote.ar: «معظم المبرمجين الجيدين لا يبرمجون لأنهم ينتظرون أجرًا أو إعجاب الجمهور، بل لأن البرمجة ممتعة.»
quote.author: LINUS TORVALDS

about.title: $ WHO AM I
about.lead: I’m a final-year Computer Science Engineering student at ENSAF in Fès. I began by teaching myself programming from scratch: algorithms on paper, then C, C++, and C#.
about.body: Today I build and ship production systems for clients across healthcare, retail and point of sale, marketplaces, and restaurant operations. I enjoy turning complex workflows and data into software people can rely on. I’m open to paid PFE internships, freelance work, CDI, CDD, and collaborations.
